messages:
incidents-bot: PAGING oncall @sam — incoming: high error rate on /v1/generate, 10:04 UTC. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/generate-high-errors :rotating_light:
sam (oncall): ack, joining bridge now.
sam (oncall): grabbing logs and queues. initial hypothesis: KV cache thrash after recent rollout.
ops-bot: deploy notice — rollout model-weights/v12 started at 10:05 UTC (canary -> 50%).
kevin: I see spike in eviction rate + CPU at the same time. autoscaler breathing limit.
sam (oncall): trying quick mitigation: bump dedicated pool by 2 nodes.
kevin: done, autoscaler manual +2. p95 latency down slightly.
elaine: customer-impact note: CS reports 2 paying customers saw timeouts, ~23k failed reqs across EU region.
priya: was this noisy paging? I got two duplicate pages for the same symptom. we should dedupe.
sam (oncall): confirmed root cause = KV eviction storm correlated w/ v12 canary. rolling back canary to v11 on affected hosts.
ops-bot: deploy notice — rollback to model-weights/v11 at 10:21 UTC.
kevin: rollback applied. metrics show error-rate falling to baseline by 10:38.
sam (oncall): service stabilized ~10:40 UTC. continuing monitoring.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — please schedule postmortem and create actions.
priya: I'll draft the postmortem. proposing retro Thu 2024-10-15 09:00 PT — who can attend?
kevin: I can.
elaine: I'll join and I can handle customer comms for affected accounts.
sam (oncall): I'll own infra/action tracker items and link telemetry.
priya: initial action items (short):
- priya: write postmortem + short timeline
- kevin: alert tuning & dedupe rules
- sam: runbook update + infra fix for KV eviction guardrails
- elaine: customer comms + CS followup
kevin: proposed alert changes: throttle pages for short spikes, dedupe by model_variant+region, add eviction-rate SLO.
priya: agree. add runbook step to auto-suppress page for rollouts with tag=rollout for 5m unless sustained.
sam (oncall): I'll open INF-4321 and attach logs + grafana links.
kevin: assigning myself to alert cleanup. plan: convert noisy alerts to warning, only page on sustained window >=2m.
elaine: also request we add a Canary suppression flag in the deployment pipeline so canary-induced noise doesn't page ops.
priya: sample alert config snippet below for discussion:
```yaml
alert: high_error_rate
severity: page
window: 2m
dedupe_by: model_variant + region
suppression:
  - tag: rollout
    grace: 5m
```
kevin: LGTM. I'll draft concrete Prometheus rules and post them to the PR.
priya: SLO followup: propose success_rate >= 99.9% per region per model_variant (30d window). add a dashboard and an SLO alert.
sam (oncall): timeline to complete action items: alert tuning (2w), runbook/infra hardening (3w), SLO/dashboard (2w).
elaine: I'll prepare customer notes for impacted customers by EOD and follow up next week.
incidents-bot: Reminder: create postmortem doc and link to incident.
priya: created postmortem draft and linked INF-4321. invite sent for Thu retro.
sam (oncall): marking owners: kevin -> alert tuning, priya -> postmortem, sam -> infra fixes, elaine -> customer comms.
kevin: plan for alert pruning: run query to find alerts that fired >50% during this incident window and start review.
priya: adding 'reduce pager noise' to the Q2 ops roadmap.
sam (oncall): closing thread — postmortem scheduled, owners assigned, action items in INF-4321. followups tracked in the incident board. :white_check_mark:
